standard_prerequisites.use: Equates the support condition with unramifiedness on an open and, flatness being automatic for curves, with etaleness on an open.

standard_prerequisites.name: Function fields and generic smoothness
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the etale-almost-everywhere condition with separability of the function field extension k(X)/k(Y).

core_obligations: Differential chain (proof lines 2580-2590): Omega sheaves are invertible; through the triangle sequence, conditions (1) and (2) are equivalent and equivalent to nonvanishing of f^*Omega_{Y/k} -> Omega_{X/k} at the generic point.
Open conditions (proof lines 2590-2596): (2) is equivalent to (3) by the unramified-omega lemma, and (3) to (4) by flat-unramified-etale with flatness automatic for a morphism of smooth curves.
Function fields (proof lines 2596-2600): (4) is equivalent to (5) via the smooth-at-generic-point lemma; the author marks the final unwinding with some details omitted while naming the citation.
proof_roadmap: Fix invertibility of the differentials and write the triangle sequence.
Translate the nonzero-transcendence-degree condition into unramifiedness on an open.
Upgrade unramified to etale using automatic flatness.
Connect etaleness on an open with separability of the function field extension.
difficulty_reason: The lemma gives five equivalent characterizations of separability for a morphism of smooth curves (statement lines 2564-2578). The proof (lines 2580-2600) is a complete equivalence chain through the differentials triangle, the unramified and etale open conditions, and the function-field criterion; the only marked omission is the final unwinding of the named smooth-at-generic-point citation, a subsidiary step. H2: a standard equivalence chain with correctly ordered citations.
